text: {"lessons":["The account fell for several periods without any trades, so I should not react to every decline; I should review my plan and risks before deciding whether to act.","My earlier profitable sale of Stock B does not show that I can reliably time prices. I should set clear reasons for selling and avoid treating gains or losses alone as a signal.","I added to Stocks C and D after they had risen. Before buying more, I should check how concentrated my holdings are and whether the purchase still fits my ten-year apartment goal."]}
